AC_audio.why: AC_audio's own par tables (Audiofile, Trim, Depth, Source, Specgain) are not defined in any file under builders/ or td/ (only builders/ac_audio_features.py, which adds just Features + Featurespath, a toggle and a string); the COMP was made ad hoc in TD, so fallback.

AU_db_meter.why: Meter essentials: input source/mode/channels, gain, dB floor/ceil, ballistics (attack/release/hold + reset), orientation and scale/peak/transparent toggles.

AU_features.why: Features page (BPM range/source, onset sensitivity/method, beat decay, loud floor, key mode, reset counters) plus Analysis on and Source.

BJ_urdu_type.why: Main = text and trigger, animation mode/timing/seconds/stagger/loop/hold, size, align, fill/outline colours, outline width, glow, shadow; macros: glow, edge (outline + shadow), animation speed.

BK_dmx_out.why: Main = send/blackout/freeze, master and its source, BPM/beat shape/depth/audio amount, test pattern, level/speed, gamma; macros: tempo (pattern speed + BPM) and response (audio amount + gamma).

BK_dmx_patch.why: Main = sync/check patch, stage view (view menu, orbit, elevation, FOV, size, fit, grid), beam and pixel look, aim toggle, reset; macros scale beam, pixel and framing preview.

BL_cloud_morph.why: Morph A to B (mode, amount, A/B generators, stagger, arc, beats per swap), point look (shape, blend, size, brightness, tint, drift) and orbit/reset; Motion, Spread, Glow and Chaos macros.

BL_splat_render.why: Camera (mode, orbit az/el/distance/speed, frame, reset), splat scale/opacity/brightness/gamma, and the Look-page dissolve/reveal/explode/drift/beat pulse; Motion, Glow, Chaos and Size macros.

BN_cloth.why: Cloth/jelly mode, reset/release/burst/pause, pins, wind and turbulence, damping, bend, time scale, shading, front/back colour, orbit.

BN_fluid2d.why: Dye colour mode and emitter colour, burst/reset/pause, audio and BPM modes, emitter force/radius, decay, vorticity, time scale, exposure, source/force gains.

BO_particles.why: Play/Reset/Burst, emit source, speed, life, curl, drag, size, brightness, bloom, colour/palette, trails and shape of the particle engine.

BP_io_router.why: Bus crossfade essentials (bus A/B, mix, fade mode/time/curve, cut, bpm, stale timeout); no macros: only 4 numeric pars and no sensible float pairs. Source/sink pars are built by string concatenation and stay on their tabs.

BX_blender_scene.why: No builder source defines its pars (searched builders/, td/, test/): none of builders/ has a blender file; only td/handlers.py and td/vat.py mention Blender and only the library README lists Camera, Lightdimmer, Ambient, Resw, Resh (the COMP was made ad hoc in TD).

CQ_cuelist.why: Main = transport (GO/back/standby/goto/stop/pause/reset), fade rate and queue mode, clock source/play/chase, default fade, tracking and autofollow; macros are weak but harmless: fade snappiness and timecode lock tolerance.

CS_cam_sequencer.why: Camera COMP preset sequencer (v2, the original's workflow): Bind, Init / Append (capture the camera + its Look At), the Select fader (fraction = blend), Easing + Ease Override + Spline Interpolation, then ours: playmode, any-to-any Go to preset, clock, quantise, shake profile + amount. Macros: Shake (profile scales + speed), Pace (hold + transition shorter), Smooth (Select lag + look damping), Lens (FOV offset + framing pad).

CV_person_mask.why: Matte (feather, grow, smooth, invert, opacity), Look (person, fill/bg, view), light wrap and despill, Vision on, source and reset smoothing.

DC_depth_cam.why: Depth page (active, mode depth/fog/slice/outline, mix, smooth, invert, mirror) plus the key pars of the Fog, Slice and Outline pages.

Effectors.why: The /project1/effectors list management (add kind/name/tags, target, toggle/remove/duplicate, track mode, sync), light palette source/shift/reverse, and the voxel grid / paint switches.

FT_face_track.why: Tracking page: on/source/mirror, face count, smoothing, confidence, hold, wire/box display and colour, mask blur/grow, calibrate.

FX_analog.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module ntsc1 (ntsc): standard, separation, dot crawl, hue, saturation, phase error, peaking, ringing, noise, gain, bandwidth.

FX_destroy.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module melt1 (melt): amount, mode, direction, gravity, drip, viscosity, recover, wobble, speed, columns, weight, seed, Reset.

FX_film.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module camera1 (camera): shutter, move blur, handheld shake, footsteps, rolling readout, exposure, ISO, overscan, zoom.

FX_glass.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module liquid1 (liquid glass; slot starts disabled): amount, shapes/mask source, refraction, bevel, frost, drift, rim, specular, tint.

FX_glitch.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module smear1 (smear): mode, amount, angle, length, threshold, decay, wobble, seed, strip width, density.

FX_haze.why: Haze body (amount, density, falloff, patchiness, drift, extinction, ambient, lit-fog tint/gain/anisotropy), shafts, bloom and ring halo, and the palette pick; Density, Shafts, Glow and Patchy macros.

FX_motion_trail.why: Trail amount/length/decay/threshold, age colouring (mode, blend, palette, new/mid/old colours, spread, cycle), hold/clear and the source pick; Trail, Sensitivity, Colour and Fade macros.

FX_palette_map.why: The whole Palette page (palette, colour space, blend, lightness weight, preserve luma, dither + amount + animate) plus the Source pick; the COMP only has about ten live pars. Strength and Grit macros.

FX_retro.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module palette1 (palette): machine, constraint, pixel size, dither, contrast, brightness, saturation.

FX_scope.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module xy1 (audio XY scope) with its shared beam pages: source, gain, intensity, phosphor, persistence, size, glow, exposure, graticule, background.

FX_strobe.why: Trigger source, flash mode/colour/depth, rhythm (every Nth, note, BPM, tap, threshold, LFO rate), attack/release, and the manual Fire/Burst/Flash/Blackout; Intensity, Snap and Speed macros.

FX_stylise.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module outline1 (outline; slot starts disabled): amount, mode, line width/offset, intensity, halo, colour source, palette position, backdrop, contour speed, wobble.

FX_synth.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module colorize1 (colorize): amount, mode, source, function, overflow, drive, bias, solarize, drift, per-channel gains, hue cycles, saturation.

FX_track.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the shared tracker pars (Key, Keygain, Threshold, Detector, Smooth) plus the first module plexus1 (plexus): amount, link radius, neighbours, line width, halo, intensity, dots, reveal.

FX_trans.why: One COMP with transition types: Type, Progress, Drive, Go/Back/Cut, Duration/Beats/Ease/Steps/Quantize/Bpm, Backstyle and the first three type-dependent knobs K1-K3; Speed and Snap macros.

GEN_clone.why: Layout (Mode/Count/grid counts/Radius), clone shape and picture source, size/colour/alpha/blend, alignment, seed, noise position, time offset and camera spin; Size, Chaos and Energy macros.

GEN_interactive.why: Rack Panic/Input and tracked-points Source/Demo pars plus the first module ribbon1 (Ribbon/Width/Style/Colour pages).

GEN_pattern.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module truchet1 (Truchet page: Amount/Tile/Levels/Subdivide/Linewidth/Flipshare) and its shared Drive/Space/Colour essentials.

GEN_points.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module density2d1 (Density page: Map/Amount/Drift) and the shared Points/Look/View/Drive essentials.

GEN_sdf.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module scene1 (Scene page: scene A/B, morph, size) with its shared Camera/Look/Colour essentials.

GEN_sim.why: Rack Panic/Input plus the first module ca1 (cellular automata: Ca, Look and Colour pages); the rack has no mix/global-amount par.

GN_physarum.why: Slime-mould presets A/B + morph, colour mode and palette, exposure/glow/value high, species and seeding, reseed/reset/burst/pause.

GN_reaction_diffusion.why: Pattern presets A/B + morph, palette, value scale, exposure, steps per frame, seeding, reset/burst/pause and audio mode.

LK_projection_room.why: Main = view/camera/dome mode menus, test chart, projector throw/lumens/gain/lens shift, content fit, frustum, projector B, readouts; macros: projector light, dome view, view aids. Pars from builders/projector_dome.py only (the older Room page pars are not in builder code).

LK_spectrum_glass.why: No builder in builders/ or td/ (made ad hoc in TD; only library/LK_spectrum_glass/README.md lists its pars and show_rig names it), so par names cannot be determined from builder code: fallback applies.

LK_typecore.why: No builder in builders/ or td/ (made ad hoc in TD; only library/LK_typecore/README.md lists its pars and show_rig names it), so par names cannot be determined from builder code: fallback applies.

LP_laser_path.why: Main = source and pattern, size/count/colour, intensity and gain, rotate and scale, intensity source/BPM, strobe, blackout, hold; macros: size, brightness, preview glow.

LY_lyrics_feed.why: Main = lyric source, timing offset, play/rate/loop/restart/seek, line sizes, next-line and bar toggles, colours, transparent bg; macros: text size (line sizes + gap) and spacing (margin + bar height).

MIDI_mapper.why: Its pars (Enable, Device, Activebank, Learn, Feedback, ...) are defined in td/handlers.py (MIDI_PARS and the par table near line 5306) and td/midi_runtime.py, not in builders/; there is no builder file for the validator to grep, and only Activebank is a numeric par.

MX_prox_material.why: Preset, proximity radius/gain/shape/flip, colour mode and near/far colours, emission and rim glow, dissolve and displace switches (pars from prox_mat_logic.py).

POP_branching.why: Branching play/reset/seed, steering and split pars, trail deposit/decay, hues and gain; macros Chaos / Growth / Glow.

POP_caustics.why: Refractor + optics, water motion, exposure/persist, composite and tint; macros Waves / Focus.

POP_collide.why: Look/emitter essentials of POP_collide (amount, reset, emitter shape, speed, gravity, wind, bounce, colour, trails) plus Energy / Chaos / Glow macros.

POP_crack3d.why: Crack style, cell scale, width, progress/auto, reach, glow, colours, object shape, spin and distance; macros Cracks / Speed / Zoom.

POP_fillbody.why: Particle motion, dancer pose/speed/scale, point look and colour; macros Energy / Glow / Pose.

POP_linegrowth.why: Growth play/reset/shape/seeds, spring physics essentials, point size, zoom and hue/gain; macros Chaos / Speed / Glow.

POP_meshwarp.why: Warp mode, strength, frequency, speed, depth, centre, shading and sheet view (tilt/orbit/zoom); macros Warp / Speed / Size.

POP_rd3d.why: Reaction-diffusion preset, play/steps/reseed, palette, surface shape/height/light and view; macros Relief / Turn.

POP_terrain.why: Terrain style, fly speed, noise shape, contour/fog, the three height colours and camera height/pitch/fov; macros Relief / Fly.

POP_tree.why: Tree structure (depth, branches, spread, twist, ratio, length, growth), sway, hues, brightness/gain, camera and composite; macros Chaos / Wind / Glow.

POP_tubes.why: Tube source, play/reset, speed, path scale, radius/taper, palette, fade/gain/halo and view; macros Energy / Glow / Thick.

PV_previz_stage.why: Main = camera preset/orbit, screen source, lights/haze/crowd on-off and their key amounts, strobe, exposure/bloom, audio to beams, reset; macros: haze, light, motion, crowd.

PX_lines.why: Line-source toggles (rings, contour, trails, connect, edges), amount/width/halo/intensity/speed/reveal, line colour and palette (Linecol, Linecolsrc, Palsource, Palshift) and Reset; Glow, Width, Energy and Chaos macros.

PX_pointfx.why: Source (Amode), look (Sprite/Size), colour (Palsource/Palshift), glow, dissolve (M4progress = dissolve_noise progress, Disrecover = heal /s), effector strength (M1strength = prox_push), camera, speed, setlist (Prev / Next scene, Transition s or beats; 28 Oct phase A, replacing Agen / Ascale / Tealorange, which stay on their pages), Reset. M<uid> names follow the default stack (1 prox_push, 2 curl, 3 prox_colour, 4 dissolve_noise).

QC_mcp_checks.why: A throw-away QC check COMP made ad hoc in TD (pars Tint RGBA, Note string, Glow RGB per library README): no builder source defines its pars, and its pars are colours/strings only.

TL_timeline.why: Main = transport (play/stop/loop/rate/seek/start/end/in/out), snap, lane, key and marker pulses, BPM; macros are weak but harmless: tempo (rate + BPM) and audio (master + clip gain).

TP_test_pattern.why: Pattern page (pattern, channel, level, area, walk + speed/reset, line width, cell, steps, face outlines) plus resolution preset and the Counter/Wheel/Flash sync toggles.

ZC_control_surface.why: Preset slot, store/recall/morph and randomise essentials; no macros: the only numeric pars are Morphtime, Randamount and ids that must not be driven.

ZK_controls_kit.why: The demo noise look's own pars (Look + Motion pages, from zkit.py DEMO_PAGES): type, period, harmonics, gain, exponent, speed, mono, tint, rotate, offset, flash, reseed; macros: detail and energy.

PX_pointfx1.why: user copy of PX_pointfx (28 Oct): same Main tab

FG_fps_governor.why: Main = the whole Governor page: Active (off = manual wins), Target fps, Downafter / Upafter hysteresis frames, Steps, Floor quality, Up headroom ms, Reset. No macros: a governor has no look to morph.
